བཏང་ཞིག: let go! (btang, the past stem of gtong 'to send, let go' (gtong / btang / gtang / thong), + zhig, which marks a command after -ng); after ma, 'do not let go'
སྤངས་པའི: of what has given up, that has abandoned (spangs, the past stem of spong 'to give up', + -pa + -'i 'of')
དབྱིངས་ཕྱུག: Lady of the Expanse (dbyings 'expanse' + phyug 'rich', as in phyug ma 'rich one, mistress'; short for dbyings phyug ma): the name of a consort goddess, and of the female deities as a host
ཁྲོ་མོའི: of the wrathful women, wrathful goddesses (khro mo 'wrathful woman' + -'i 'of')
བྲལ: parted, be separated (bral 'be separated, be free of'); takes dang 'from': X dang bral 'parted from X'
གཅིག་པུར: alone, by oneself (gcig pu 'single one, alone' + -r)
ཕྱུངས: send forth! bring out! (phyungs, the imperative of 'byin 'to bring out' ('byin / phyung / dbyung / phyungs))
འཇིགས་ང: as printed, uncertain: 'jigs 'fear' followed by a doubtful syllable nga that is not a word; perhaps for 'jigs snang 'fearful appearance' or 'jigs pa 'fear'; read 'fear(?)'
ཤོག: may it be, let it come about (shog, the imperative of 'ong 'to come', 'come!'; after a verb it closes a wish): 'gyur bar shog 'may it become'
ཞི: calm, peaceful (zhi 'be calm'); zhi dang khro bo 'the peaceful and the wrathful'
ཙ་ན: when, at the time when (tsa na), after a verb
སེལ་བར: to dispel, to clear away (sel 'clear away, dispel' + -bar 'to'); sel bar shog 'may it dispel'
ཡིག་དྲུག: the six syllables (yig 'letter, syllable' + drug 'six'); the six-syllable mantra
སྒྲ་རུ: into sound, as sound (sgra 'sound' + -ru 'into, as'); where 'sound' gives no sense, perhaps for dgra ru 'as enemies' (uncertain)
འགྱུར་བར: to become, to turn into ('gyur 'change, become' + -bar 'to'); 'gyur bar shog 'may it become'
འབྲང: to follow, to go after ('brang, the present stem; past 'brangs)
སྐྱབ་ཏུ: to protect (skyab, a spelling of bskyab, the future stem of skyob 'protect' (skyob / bskyabs / bskyab / skyobs), + -tu 'to'); skyab tu gsol 'I pray that you protect'
བདེ་བའི: of bliss, of happiness (bde ba 'bliss, happiness' + -'i 'of')
ཏིང་འཛིན: meditative absorption, samādhi (ting 'dzin, short for ting nge 'dzin)
འཆར་བར: to dawn, to appear ('char 'dawn, appear' + -bar 'to'); 'char bar shog 'may it dawn'
འབྱུང་ལྔའི: of the five elements ('byung, short for 'byung ba 'element', + lnga 'five' + -'i 'of'): earth, water, fire, wind and space
བཅས་པས: because of being together with, accompanied by (bcas pa 'accompanied' + -s); X dang bcas pas 'together with X'
ལོངས་སྐུར: as the body of enjoyment (longs sku 'body of enjoyment', short for longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku, + -r 'as')
གལ་ཆེའོ: is important (gal che 'important, of great consequence' + the sentence-ending -'o)
འམ: or ('am, the 'or' particle; usually joined to the word or matched to its final, gsum mam, but also written as its own syllable): lan gsum 'am bdun 'three or seven times'
དགོས་པས: because of needing, must (dgos 'be needed, must' + -pas 'because')
བསྟན་ཏོ: is shown, was taught (bstan, the past and future stem of ston 'to show, teach', + the sentence-ending -to, the form after bstan, from its old spelling bstand)
གོམ་པ: familiarity, practice (a spelling of goms pa; goms 'get used to' + -pa)
ཆེ་ཆུང: great or small, large and small (che 'big' + chung 'small')
འཁྲུལ་བ: being confused, being mistaken, delusion ('khrul 'be confused' + -ba)
མང་བས: because of being many, because there are many (mang 'many' + -ba + -s 'because')
བེམ་རིག: matter and knowing (bem, short for bem po 'inert matter', the body, + rig, short for rig pa 'knowing, awareness'): body and mind
རིག་ཐོག་ཏུ: on knowing, in awareness itself (rig, short for rig pa 'knowing, awareness', + thog 'top' + -tu 'on')
གསོན་པའི: of the living, of being alive (gson pa 'alive' + -'i 'of'), another spelling of gson po'i
དེ་བས་ན: therefore, for that reason (de 'that' + bas 'than, from' + na 'when, then')
བྱང་བར: to be trained, made thorough (byang 'purified, trained' + -ba + -r 'to'); yid la byang bar byed 'make it trained in the mind, learn by heart'
བྱེད་པ: doing, making (byed 'do, make' + -pa); one who does
བཅང་བར: to keep, to hold (bcang, the future stem of 'chang 'hold', + -bar 'to')
ཆུབ་པར: to be mastered, learned thoroughly (chub 'be learned, mastered' + -par 'to'); kun chub par 'to master entirely'
ཚུལ་བཞིན་དུ: in the proper way, as it ought to be (tshul bzhin 'in accordance with the manner' + -du)
དུས་གསུམ་དུ: at the three times (dus 'time' + gsum 'three' + -du 'at'): the three times (past, present, future) or the three periods of the day
ཆག་པར: to break off, without breaking (chag, past of 'chag 'be broken, break off', + -par 'to'); ma chag par 'without a break'
དེད: chase, pursuit (ded, taken as a noun from 'ded 'to drive, to chase'); X'i ded nas 'chased by X'
མཚམས་མེད་པ: without interval (mtshams 'gap, interval' + med pa 'without'); mtshams med pa lnga 'the five deeds without interval', the five worst deeds
བྱས་པའི: of what is done, who has done (byas, the past stem of byed 'do', + -pa + -'i 'of')
ཚོར་བས: by perceiving, by hearing, because of perceiving (tshor 'perceive, feel' + -ba + -s 'by')
གསོན: alive, living (gson); gson dus su 'at the time of being alive'
སྔས་སུ: at the pillow, at the head of the bed (sngas 'pillow' + -su 'at')
ཤི་བའི: of the dead, of one who has died (shi, the past stem of 'chi 'to die', + -ba + -'i 'of')
རྒྱ་ཆེར: widely, far and wide (rgya che 'wide, vast' + -r)
བསགས: gathered, accumulated (bsags, the past stem of gsog 'gather')
སྒྲིབ་པ: obscuration, what veils the mind (sgrib pa)
མ་གཏོགས་པ: apart from, except (ma gtogs pa, 'not counting')
འཕྲད་པར: to meet, to come upon ('phrad 'meet' + -par 'to'); X dang 'phrad par 'to meet X'
དཀའོ: is hard, is difficult (dka' 'difficult' + the sentence-ending -'o)
ཤོང་བར: to fit into, to have room for (shong 'fit, have room' + -bar 'to')
གཅེས་སྤྲས་སུ: as precious, as cherished (gces 'dear' + spras 'adorned' + -su 'as'); gces spras su bya 'treat as precious'
བལྟས་པ: seeing, looking, having looked (bltas, the past stem of lta 'to look', + -pa)
རྫོགས་སོ: is complete, is finished (rdzogs 'be complete' + the sentence-ending -so)
ཉི་ཟླ་སངས་རྒྱས: Nyi zla sangs rgyas, a personal name, 'Sun-Moon Buddha' (nyi 'sun' + zla 'moon' + sangs rgyas 'buddha'); the father of Karma Gling pa
གྲུབ་ཐོབ: one who has gained accomplishment, adept, siddha (grub 'accomplishment' + thob 'gain')
ཀརྨ་གླིང་པས: by Karma Gling pa (Karma Gling pa + -s 'by'): a name, the treasure-revealer who brought this text out
གསེར་ལྡན: Gser ldan, a river's name, 'having gold' (gser 'gold' + ldan 'having')
སྒམ་པོ་བདར: as printed, uncertain: Sgam po bdar, a place name (the other recension has sgam po gdar)
འདྲ་བའི: of what is like, like, resembling ('dra ba 'like' + -'i 'of')
གདན་དྲངས་པའོ: was invited, was brought out (gdan drangs, the respectful 'invite', drangs the past stem of 'dren 'to lead', + -pa + the sentence-ending -'o)
ཆོས་རྗེ་གླིང་པ: Chos rje Gling pa, a personal name (chos rje 'lord of the teaching', a title, + Gling pa); the son of Karma Gling pa
ལུང: transmission, the authorisation to practise a text given by reading it aloud (lung); also 'scripture'
གུ་རུ: guru, teacher (Sanskrit guru, written in Tibetan letters)
སུ་རྱ་ཙནྡྲ: Sūryacandra, a personal name in Sanskrit, 'Sun-Moon' (written su rya tsandra); a guru in the line of transmission
རིམ་པར: in sequence, in order, one after another (rim pa 'sequence' + -r)
བབས་པ: came down, descended (babs, the past stem of 'bab 'to descend', + -pa)
ལགས་སོ: is (the respectful word, lags 'is' + the sentence-ending -so)
དྲུང་དུ: in the presence of, near (drung 'nearness, presence' + -du 'in')
གྷ་གྷ་དྷརྨ་པ་མུ་དྲས: Gha gha dharma pa mu dra, a personal name, half in Sanskrit letters (gha gha dharma pa mu dra + -s 'by'); as printed, uncertain (the other recension has ga ga dharma pa mu dras)
ཞུས་སོ: requested, received a teaching (zhus, the humble past of zhu 'ask, request', + the sentence-ending -so)

__broaden__.གཏད: aimed, directed, placed toward (past of gtod) · handed over, entrusted (gtad, past of gtod): bka' dang lung gtad 'entrusted the word and the transmission'
__broaden__.སྐུ་གཟུགས: image of a deity, a statue or painting (sku 'body' + gzugs 'form') · bodily form, the form in which a deity appears (sku 'body', respectful, + gzugs 'form')
